scope.summary: Expose an insertable, deduped catalog of special characters, break characters, and white-space characters (InDesign/Illustrator special-character and break menus). Break characters interact with the paragraph keep/flow model ([STU-TYP-037]) and threaded flow ([STU-TYP-005]). Normative catalog: Symbols/special (em/en dash, ellipsis, bullet, copyright, registered, trademark, section, paragraph mark, single/double typographer quotes, degree, discretionary hyphen, non-breaking hyphen); Markers (current/next/previous page number, section marker, footnote/endnote reference marker, anchored-object marker); Break characters (forced line break, column break, frame break, page break, odd-page break, even-page break, paragraph return); White-space (em/en space, third/quarter/sixth space, thin space, hair space, figure space, punctuation space, flush space, non-breaking space fixed+flexible).
expected_tests: live: insert each catalog category (symbols/markers/breaks/white-space); break chars drive keep/flow + threaded flow
argus: catalog menu with stable author_ids
acceptance_criteria_original: deduped catalog of symbols/markers/break/white-space chars; break chars interact with keep/flow + threading

target_entries: Studio / Typography / Special characters, breaks & spaces

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-TYP-022] Special-character and break/white-space catalogs: Studio MUST expose an insertable, deduped catalog of special characters, break characters, and white-space characters (provenance: InDesign/Illustrator special-character and break menus). Break characters interact with the paragraph keep/flow model ([STU-TYP-037]) and threaded flow ([STU-TYP-005]). The normative catalog is: | Catalog | Members (non-exhaustive, deduped) | |---|---| | Symbols / special | Em dash, en dash, ellipsis, bullet, copyright, registered, trademark, section, paragraph mark, single/double typographer quotes, degree, discretionary hyphen, non-breaking hyphen | | Markers | Current page number, next/previous page number, section marker, footnote/endnote reference marker, anchored-object marker | | Break characters | Forced line break, column break, frame break, page break, odd-page break, even-page break, paragraph return | | White-space characters | Em space, en space, third/quarter/sixth space, thin space, hair space, figure space, punctuation space, flush space, non-breaking space (fixed and flexible width) |

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
